$comment: Appendix B - Go-live readiness gate, Playbook v5. Criteria are binary and evidenced - if not met, the date moves rather than the standard. Each carries the evidence artifact required. An unmet criterion is a no-go unless the named decision-maker records a documented exception.

items.text: Practice, all locations and all providers built and verified
All user accounts created with correct role-based permissions
Service types, visit types, note templates and .phrases signed off by providers
Provider schedules built and future appointments loaded correctly
Fee schedule and charge preference lists loaded
All required training delivered; make-ups complete; no untrained user going live
Super users identified and trained at every site
Fax number ported, or an accepted interim plan documented
Inbound fax routing tested to every queue; outbound tested from within a chart
Outbound caller ID confirmed correct
Sola merchant account approved; terminals delivered and configured
Test payment, void and refund completed and posted correctly
Every prescriber has completed identity proofing
EPCS enabled and logical access control approval completed where required
Test prescription successfully transmitted for every prescriber
Clearinghouse connection live; payer IDs mapped
EDI enrollment approved for all major payers, or a hold-billing plan agreed
Real-time eligibility tested and returning correctly for major payers
Test claim batch submitted and accepted end to end
ERA auto-posting rules configured and mapped
Legacy A/R plan agreed in writing — owner, system, duration
Legacy read-only access agreed — duration, cost, who pays
Test data migration validated and signed off by the practice
Production export date confirmed with the legacy vendor
Legacy data entry freeze time communicated practice-wide
Rita rules configured, scenario-tested and signed off
Dress rehearsal completed successfully
First-week schedule reduced to an agreed volume
Enrollment tracker complete with 837, 835 and EFT status and approval dates per payer
835 ERA confirmed enrolled and routing to EHR 360 for payers covering 80% of collections
Where 835 is unconfirmed, manual posting contingency briefed to the billing team
Payer table variants collapsed and re-mapped to the clearinghouse payer list
Implementation type recorded in the project record
Denial receiving point established — 835 to worklist and faxed denials to a routing queue
Address book loaded; test referral and test prescription resolve correctly
Legacy access end date, terms and cost confirmed in writing
Hypercare support plan and escalation contacts published
